artists.biography: Von Hertzen Brothers is a Finnish progressive rock band. It consists of three brothers Kie, Mikko and Jonne von Hertzen. On their album Love Remains the Same (2008), Mikko Kaakkurinniemi (drums, percussion) and Juha Kuoppala (piano, keyboards) are listed as part of Von Hertzen Brothers.  Their debut album Experience was released in 2001 and re-released in 2006. In 2006, they released their second album titled Approach. Their third album, Love Remains the Same, came out on the 14th of May 2008 and went straight to #1 on the official Finnish album charts. Their next album Stars Aligned  was released on 23. March 2011.  Their 5th album Nine Lives was released on March 21st 2013 with an official video for the single "Flowers And Rust"  Official site: www.VonHertzenBrothers.com

perplexity.description:
War Is Over" is the seventh studio album by Finnish rock band Von Hertzen Brothers, released in 2017 on Music Theories Recordings. The album marks a return to a more progressive rock sound after the band's previous two albums leaned toward straightforward AOR and melodic rock. Musically, "War Is Over" blends intricate arrangements, soaring melodies, and strong musicianship, showcasing the band's signature blend of rock, prog, and pop sensibilities. The title track, a 12-minute epic, sets the tone with its dynamic shifts, lush keyboards, and atmospheric guitar work, while the rest of the album balances ambitious compositions with accessible songwriting.

Within the band's discography, "War Is Over" stands out as a pivotal release, signaling a creative resurgence after a brief hiatus. It was well received by critics, who praised its ambitious songwriting, melodic depth, and the band's ability to deliver complex material with emotional resonance. The album reached number 4 on the Finnish charts, reflecting its strong commercial performance in their home country. Overall, "War Is Over" is regarded as a highlight in Von Hertzen Brothers' catalog, reaffirming their reputation as leading figures in Scandinavian progressive rock.
